description: Validate L0 raw evidence envelope without interpreting source semantics

script.source: if(ctx.organization==null||ctx.organization.id==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException('missing organization.id');if(ctx.ueba==null||ctx.ueba.source==null||ctx.ueba.source.type==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException('missing ueba.source.type');if(ctx.event==null||ctx.event.original==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException('missing event.original');if(ctx.ueba.provenance==null||ctx.ueba.provenance.raw_event_id==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException('missing ueba.provenance.raw_event_id');
